verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס לִכְלוֹת דְּבַר־יְהוָה מִפִּי יִרְמְיָה הֵעִיר יְהוָה אֶת־רוּחַ כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס וַיַּעֲבֶר־קוֹל בְּכָל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּב לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now in the first year of Koresh king of Paras, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Yirmeya might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Koresh king of Paras, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס כֹּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהוּא־פָקַד עָלַי לִבְנוֹת־לוֹ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Thus says Koresh king of Paras, The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him a house at Yerushalayim, which is in Yehuda.

verses.hebrew: מִי־בָכֶם מִכָּל־עַמּוֹ יְהִי אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וְיַעַל לִירוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וְיִבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Whoever is among you of all his people, let his God be with him, and let him go up to Yerushalayim, which is in Yehuda, and build the house of the Lord God of Yisra᾽el; (he is the God,) which is in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנִּשְׁאָר מִכָּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָר־שָׁם יְנַשְּׂאוּהוּ אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמוֹ בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִרְכוּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָה עִם־הַנְּדָבָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And whoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, besides the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִיהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכֹל הֵעִיר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־רוּחוֹ לַעֲלוֹת לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Then rose up the chiefs of the fathers’ houses of Yehuda and Binyamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had stirred to go up to build the house of the Lord which is in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם חִזְּקוּ בִידֵיהֶם בִּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף בַּזָּהָב בָּרְכוּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַמִּגְדָּנוֹת לְבַד עַל־כָּל־הִתְנַדֵּב׃
verses.english: And all they who were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, besides all that was willingly offered.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ כּוֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִיא אֶת־כְּלֵי בֵית־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מִירוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס עַל־יַד מִתְרְדָת הַגִּזְבָּר וַיִּסְפְּרֵם לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר הַנָּשִׂיא לִיהוּדָה׃

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מִסְפָּרָם אֲגַרְטְלֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶסֶף אָלֶף מַחֲלָפִים תִּשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.hebrew: כָּל־כֵּלִים לַזָּהָב וְלַכֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת הַכֹּל הֶעֱלָה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר עִם הֵעָלוֹת הַגּוֹלָה מִבָּבֶל לִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: the children of Levana, the children of Ḥagava, the children of ῾Aqquv,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־חָגָב בְּנֵי־שמלי [שַׁלְמַי] בְּנֵי חָנָן׃
verses.english: the children of Ḥagav, the children of Salmay, the children of Ḥanan,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־גִדֵּל בְּנֵי־גַחַר בְּנֵי רְאָיָה׃
verses.english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gaĥar, the children of Re᾽aya,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־רְצִין בְּנֵי־נְקוֹדָא בְּנֵי גַזָּם׃
verses.english: the children of Reżin, the children of Neqoda, the children of Gazzam,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־עֻזָּא בְנֵי־פָסֵחַ בְּנֵי בֵסָי׃
verses.english: the children of ῾Uzza, the children of Paseaĥ, the children of Besay,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אַסְנָה בְנֵי־מעינים [מְעוּנִים] בְּנֵי נפיסים [נְפוּסִים׃]
verses.english: the children of Asna, the children of Me῾unim, the children of Nefusim,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּוּק בְּנֵי־חֲקוּפָא בְּנֵי חַרְחוּר׃
verses.english: the children of Baqbuq, the children of Ḥaqufa, the children of Ḥarĥur,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַצְלוּת בְּנֵי־מְחִידָא בְּנֵי חַרְשָׁא׃
verses.english: the children of Bażlut, the children of Meĥida, the children of Ḥarsha,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַרְקוֹס בְּנֵי־סִיסְרָא בְּנֵי־תָמַח׃
verses.english: the children of Barqos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temaĥ,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נְצִיחַ בְּנֵי חֲטִיפָא׃
verses.english: the children of Neżiaĥ, the children of Ḥatifa.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנֵי־סֹטַי בְּנֵי־הַסֹּפֶרֶת בְּנֵי פְרוּדָא׃
verses.english: The children of the servants of Shelomo: the children of Sotay, the children of Soferet, the children of Peruda,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָה בְנֵי־דַרְקוֹן בְּנֵי גִדֵּל׃
verses.english: the children of Ya῾ala, the children of Darqon, the children of Giddel,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה בְנֵי־חַטִּיל בְּנֵי פֹּכֶרֶת הַצְּבָיִים בְּנֵי אָמִי׃
verses.english: the children of Shefatya, the children of Ḥattil, the children of Pokheret-hażevayim, the children of Ami.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃
verses.english: All the temple servants, and the children of the servants of Shelomo were three hundred and ninety two.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדָּן אִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם׃
verses.english: And these were they who went up from Tel-melaĥ, Tel-ĥarsha, Keruv, Addan, and Immer, but they could not tell their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Yisra᾽el:

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּה בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם׃
verses.english: the children of Delaya, the children of Tovya, the children of Neqoda, six hundred and fifty two.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי חֳבַיָּה בְּנֵי הַקּוֹץ בְּנֵי בַרְזִלַּי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִבְּנוֹת בַּרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי אִשָּׁה וַיִּקָּרֵא עַל־שְׁמָם׃
verses.english: And of the children of the priests: the children of Ḥovayya, the children of Haqqoż; the children of Barzillay, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillay the Gil῾adite, and was called after their name:

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָאוּ וַיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּה׃
verses.english: these sought their register among those who were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore they were excluded from the priesthood as unfit.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד כֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וּלְתֻמִּים׃
verses.english: And the governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Tummim.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים׃
verses.english: The whole congregation together was forty two thousand three hundred and sixty,

verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיהֶם אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה וְלָהֶם מְשֹׁרְרִים וּמְשֹׁרְרוֹת מָאתָיִם׃
verses.english: besides their men servants and women servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

verses.hebrew: סוּסֵיהֶם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה פִּרְדֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty six; their mules, two hundred and forty five;

verses.hebrew: גְּמַלֵּיהֶם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים׃
verses.english: their camels, four hundred and thirty five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת בְּבוֹאָם לְבֵית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם הִתְנַדְּבוּ לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים לְהַעֲמִידוֹ עַל־מְכוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: And some of the chiefs of fathers’ houses, when they came to the house of the Lord which is at Yerushalayim, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in its place:

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹחָם נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּאות וָאֶלֶף וְכֶסֶף מָנִים חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְכָתְנֹת כֹּהֲנִים מֵאָה׃
verses.english: they gave after their ability to the treasury of the work sixty one thousand drachmas of gold, and five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּמִן־הָעָם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים בְּעָרֵיהֶם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, dwelt in their cities, and all Yisra᾽el in their cities.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִים וַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Yisra᾽el were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וּזְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְאֶחָיו וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עֹלוֹת כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Then stood up Yeshua the son of Yożadaq, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbavel the son of She᾽alti᾽el, and his brethren, and they built the altar of the God of Yisra᾽el, to offer burnt offerings upon it, as it is written in the Tora of Moshe the man of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת ויעל [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃
verses.english: And they set the altar upon its bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings upon it to the Lord, burnt offerings morning and evening.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: And they kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the prescribed form, as the duty of every day required;

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵיכֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכָל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: and afterwards they offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the sacred appointed seasons of the Lord, and on behalf of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃
verses.english: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the Lord. But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־כֶסֶף לַחֹצְבִים וְלֶחָרָשִׁים וּמַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה וָשֶׁמֶן לַצִּדֹנִים וְלַצֹּרִים לְהָבִיא עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן אֶל־יָם יָפוֹא כְּרִשְׁיוֹן כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: They gave money also to the masons, and to the carpenters; and food, and drink, and oil, to those of Żidon, and of Żor, to bring cedar trees from the Levanon to the sea of Yafo, according to the grant that they had from Koresh king of Paras.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְכָל־הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now in the second year of their coming to the house of God at Yerushalayim, in the second month, began Zerubbavel the son of She᾽alti᾽el, and Yeshua the son of Yożadaq, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they who were come out of the captivity to Yerushalayim; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upwards, to superintend the work of the house of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃
verses.english: Then stood Yeshua with his sons and his brethren, Qadmi’el and his sons, the sons of Yehuda, together, to superintend the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Ḥenadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

verses.hebrew: וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the Lord, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaf with cymbals, to praise the Lord, according to the form prescribed by David king of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And they sang responsively in praising and giving thanks to the Lord; because he is good, for his steadfast love endures for ever towards Yisra᾽el. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

verses.hebrew: וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיָסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃
verses.english: But many of the priests and Levites and the chiefs of the fathers’ houses, old men who had seen the first house; when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; but many shouted aloud for joy:

verses.hebrew: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃
verses.english: so that the people could not distinguish the sound of the shout of joy from the sound of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the sound was heard afar off.
Now when the adversaries of Yehuda and Binyamin heard that the children of the exiles were building the temple to the Lord God of Yisra᾽el;

then they came to Zerubbavel, and to the chiefs of the fathers’ houses and said to them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as you do; and we have sacrificed to him since the days of Esar-ĥaddon king of Ashshur, who brought us up here.

But Zerubbavel and Yeshua, and the rest of the chiefs of the fathers’ houses of Yisra᾽el, said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves alone will build to the Lord God of Yisra᾽el, as king Koresh the king of Paras has commanded us.
Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Yehuda, and frightened them off from building,
and they hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Koresh king of Paras, until the reign of Daryavesh king of Paras.
And in the reign of Aĥashverosh, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote to him an accusation against the inhabitants of Yehuda and Yerushalayim.

And in the days of Artaĥshasta, Bishlam, Mitredat, Tave᾽el, and the rest of their companions, wrote to Artaĥshasta, king of Paras; and the writing of the letter was written in the Aramic script, and translated into the Aramic tongue.

verses.hebrew: רְחוּם בַּעַל־פְּקֻדָּה וְשִׁמְשַׁי הַסּוֹפֵר, כָּתְבוּ אִגֶּרֶת אַחַת עַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ, כֵּן.
verses.english: Reĥum the chancellor and Shimshay the scribe wrote a letter against Yerushalayim to Artaĥshasta the king in this sort:

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי רְחוּם בַּעַל־פְּקֻדָּה וְשִׁמְשַׁי הַסּוֹפֵר וּשְׁאָר חַבְרֵיהֶם, הַדִּינִים וְהַפַּרְסִים, הַנִּטְפָּלִים, הַפַּרְסִים, הָאָרִיִּים, הַבַּבְלִים, הַשּׁוּשַׁנִּים, שֶׁהוּא הָעֵלָמִים.
verses.english: then wrote Reĥum the chancellor, and Shimshay the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinites, the Afarsatkhites, the Tarpelites, the Afarsites, the Arkevites, the Bavlites, the Shushankhites, the Dehites, the ῾Elamites,

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר הָאֻמּוֹת, אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה אָסְנַפַּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנִּכְבָּד, וְהוֹשִׁיב אוֹתָם בְּקִרְיָה שֶׁל שֹׁמְרוֹן, וּשְׁאָר עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, וְכָעֵת.
verses.english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and placed in the cities of Shomeron, and the rest who are on this side of the river. And now,

verses.hebrew: זֶה הֶעְתֵּק הָאִגֶּרֶת, אֲשֶׁר שָׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו אֶל אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ: עֲבָדֶיךָ אִישׁ עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, וְכָעֵת.
verses.english: this is the copy of the letter that they sent to him, to Artaĥshasta the king; Thy servants the men on this side of the river. And now,

verses.hebrew: יָדוּעַ יְהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ, שֶׁהַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר עָלוּ מֵאִתְּךָ אֵלֵינוּ, בָּאוּ לִירוּשָׁלַיִם, הַקִּרְיָה הַמּוֹרֶדֶת וְהָרָעָה בּוֹנִים, וְהַחוֹמוֹת הִשְׁלִימוּ וְהַיְּסוֹדוֹת יְחַזֵּקוּ.
verses.english: Be it known to the king, that the Jews who came up from thee to us are come to Yerushalayim; they are building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up its walls, and joined the foundations.

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת, יָדוּעַ יְהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ, שֶׁאִם קִרְיָה זוֹ תִּבָּנֶה וְהַחוֹמוֹת יֻשְׁלְמוּ, מַתָּת, מִנְחָה וּמַס לֹא יִתְּנוּ, וְלִבְסוֹף מְלָכִים תַּזִּיק.
verses.english: Be it known now to the king, that, if this city is built, and the walls set up again, then they will not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so the revenue of the kings will suffer damage.

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת, כָּל־עֻמַּת שֶׁמֶּלַח הַהֵיכָל מָלַחְנוּ וְעֶרְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא יָאֶה לָנוּ לִרְאוֹת, עַל זֹאת שָׁלַחְנוּ וְהוֹדַעְנוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ.
verses.english: Now because we feel closely bound to the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore we have sent and certified the king;

verses.hebrew: שֶׁיְּבַקֵּר בְּסֵפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת שֶׁל אֲבוֹתֶיךָ, וְתִמְצָא בְּסֵפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת וְתֵדַע, שֶׁקִּרְיָה זוֹ קִרְיָה מוֹרֶדֶת, וּמַזֶּקֶת מְלָכִים וּמְדִינוֹת, וְאַלִּימוּת עוֹשִׂים בְּתוֹכָהּ מִימוֹת עוֹלָם; עַל זֶה קִרְיָה זוֹ הָחֳרָבָה.
verses.english: that search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city laid waste.

verses.hebrew: מוֹדִיעִים אֲנַחְנוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ, שֶׁאִם קִרְיָה זוֹ תִּבָּנֶה וְהַחוֹמוֹת יֻשְׁלְמוּ, לְעֻמַּת זֶה חֵלֶק בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר אֵין לָךְ.
verses.english: We make known to the king that, if this city is rebuilt and its walls set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side of the river.

verses.hebrew: אֶת הַצַּו שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל רְחוּם בַּעַל־פְּקֻדָּה וְשִׁמְשַׁי הַסּוֹפֵר וּשְׁאָר חַבְרֵיהֶם, שֶׁיּוֹשְׁבִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וּשְׁאָר עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר: שָׁלוֹם, וְכָעֵת.
verses.english: Then the king sent an answer to Reĥum the chancellor, and to Shimshay the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who dwelt in Shomeron, and to the rest beyond the river. Peace. And now,

verses.hebrew: הָאִגֶּרֶת אֲשֶׁר שְׁלַחְתֶּם אֵלֵינוּ, מְפֹרָשׁ נִקְרְאָה לְפָנַי.
verses.english: the letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנִּי הוּשַׂם צַו, וּבִקְּרוּ וּמָצְאוּ, שֶׁקִּרְיָה זוֹ מִימוֹת עוֹלָם עַל מְלָכִים מִתְנַשֵּׂאת, וּמֶרֶד וְאַלִּימוּת נַעֲשֶׂה בָּהּ.
verses.english: And I commanded, and search has been made, and it is found that this city of old time made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition were made in it.

verses.hebrew: וּמְלָכִים חֲזָקִים הָיוּ עַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, וְשׁוֹלְטִים בְּכָל עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, וּמַתָּת, מִנְחָה וּמַס נִתָּן לָהֶם.
verses.english: And there have been mighty kings over Yerushalayim, who ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid to them.

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת, שִׂימוּ צַו לְבַטֵּל הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה, וְקִרְיָה זוֹ לֹא תִּבָּנֶה, עַד מִמֶּנִּי צַו יוּשָׂם.
verses.english: Therefore make a decree to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not rebuilt, until a further decree is given from me.

verses.hebrew: וּזְהִירִים הֱיוּ מֵעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁגֶּה עַל זֶה, שֶׁמָּא יִרְבֶּה הַהֶפְסֵד לְהַזָּקַת מְלָכִים.
verses.english: Take heed now not to be slack in this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי מִשֶּׁהֶעְתֵּק הָאִגֶּרֶת שֶׁל אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ נִקְרָא לִפְנֵי רְחוּם וְשִׁמְשַׁי הַסּוֹפֵר וְחַבְרֵיהֶם, הָלְכוּ בִבְהִילוּת לִירוּשָׁלַיִם אֶל הַיְּהוּדִים, וּבִטְּלוּ אוֹתָם בִּזְרוֹעַ וָחָיִל.
verses.english: Now when the copy of king Artaĥshasta’s letter was read before Reĥum, and Shimshay the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Yerushalayim to the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי בָּטְלָה עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וְהָיְתָה בְּטֵלָה עַד שְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס.
verses.english: Then the work of the house of God which is at Yerushalayim ceased. So it ceased until the second year of the reign of Daryavesh king of Paras.

verses.hebrew: וְנִבָּא חַגַּי הַנָּבִיא וּזְכַרְיָה בֶּן עִדּוֹא הַנְּבִיאִים, עַל הַיְּהוּדִים אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם, בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲלֵיהֶם.
verses.english: Then the prophets, Ḥaggay the prophet, and Zekharya the son of ῾Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Yehuda and Yerushalayim in the name of the God of Yisra᾽el, even to them.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי קָמוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק, וְהֵחֵלּוּ לִבְנוֹת אֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וְעִמָּהֶם נְבִיאֵי הָאֱלֹהִים תּוֹמְכִים אוֹתָם.
verses.english: Then rose up Zerubbavel the son of She᾽alti᾽el, and Yeshua the son of Yożadaq, and began to build the house of God which is at Yerushalayim: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.

verses.hebrew: בּוֹ בַּזְּמַן, בָּא אֲלֵיהֶם תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וְחַבְרֵיהֶם, וְכֵן אוֹמְרִים לָהֶם: מִי שָׂם לָכֶם צַו, בַּיִת זֶה לִבְנוֹת וְחוֹמָה זוֹ לְהַשְׁלִים?
verses.english: At the same time came to them Tattenay, governor on this side of the river, and Shetar-bozenay, and their companions, and said thus to them, Who has commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי כֵּן אָמַרְנוּ לָהֶם, מִי הֵם שְׁמוֹת אֲנָשִׁים, שֶׁבּוֹנִים בִּנְיָן זֶה.
verses.english: We then spoke to them after this manner: What are the names of the men who are engaged on this building?

verses.hebrew: וְעֵין אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הָיְתָה עַל זִקְנֵי הַיְּהוּדִים, וְלֹא בִּטְּלוּ אוֹתָם עַד שֶׁהַפְּקֻדָּה אֶל דָּרְיָוֶשׁ תֵּלֵךְ, וַאֲזַי יָשִׁיבוּ אִגֶּרֶת עַל זֶה.
verses.english: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Daryavesh: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.

verses.hebrew: הֶעְתֵּק הָאִגֶּרֶת, אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וַחֲבֵרָיו, הַפַּרְסִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, אֶל דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ.
verses.english: The copy of the letter that Tattenay, governor on this side of the river, and Shetar-bozenay, and his companions the Afarsekhites, who were on this side of the river, sent to Daryavesh the king:

verses.hebrew: הַדָּבָר שָׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו, וְכָזֹאת כָּתוּב בְּתוֹכוֹ: לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ כָּל הַשָּׁלוֹם.
verses.english: they sent a letter to him, and in it was written thus; To Daryavesh the king, all peace.

verses.hebrew: יָדוּעַ יְהִי לַמֶּלֶךְ, שֶׁהָלַכְנוּ לִיהוּדָה הַמְּדִינָה, לְבֵית הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל, וְהוּא נִבְנֶה אֶבֶן גָּלָל וְעֵץ מוּשָׂם בַּכְּתָלִים, וַעֲבוֹדָה זוֹ בְּמֶרֶץ נַעֲשֵׂית וּמַצְלִיחָה בְּיָדָם.
verses.english: Be it known to the king, that we went into the province of Yehuda, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goes on with diligence, and prospers in their hands.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי שָׁאַלְנוּ לַזְּקֵנִים אֵלֶּה, כֵּן אָמַרְנוּ לָהֶם: מִי שָׂם לָכֶם צַו, בַּיִת זֶה לִבְנוֹת וְחוֹמָה זוֹ לְהַשְׁלִים?
verses.english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

verses.hebrew: וְאַף שְׁמוֹתֵיהֶם שָׁאַלְנוּ אוֹתָם לְהוֹדִיעֲךָ, שֶׁנִּכְתֹּב שֵׁם הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶם.
verses.english: We asked their names also, to make known to thee, that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

verses.hebrew: וְכֵן הַדָּבָר הֱשִׁיבוּנוּ לֵאמֹר: אֲנַחְנוּ הֵם עֲבָדָיו שֶׁל אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ, וּבוֹנִים בַּיִת אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בָנוּי מִלִּפְנֵי זֶה שָׁנִים רַבּוֹת, וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בָּנָהוּ וְהִשְׁלִימוֹ.
verses.english: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Yisra᾽el did build and set up.

verses.hebrew: אֶלָּא מִשֶּׁהִכְעִיסוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, נָתַן אוֹתָם בְּיַד נבוכדנצר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל הַכַּשְׂדִּי, וּבַיִת זֶה הֶחֱרִיבוֹ וְאֶת הָעָם הֶגְלָה לְבָבֶל.
verses.english: But because our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to anger, he gave them into the hand of Nevukhadneżżar the king of Bavel, the Kasdian, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Bavel.

verses.hebrew: אוּלָם בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל, כּוֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂם צַו, בֵּית אֱלֹהִים זֶה לִבְנוֹת.
verses.english: But in the first year of Koresh the king of Bavel the same king Koresh made a decree to build this house of God.

verses.hebrew: וְאַף הַכֵּלִים שֶׁל בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים שֶׁל זָהָב וָכֶסֶף, אֲשֶׁר נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הוֹצִיא מִן הַהֵיכָל אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם וְהוֹבִיל אוֹתָם לַהֵיכָל שֶׁל בָּבֶל, הוֹצִיא אוֹתָם כּוֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ מִן הַהֵיכָל שֶׁל בָּבֶל, וְנִתְּנוּ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר שְׁמוֹ, אֲשֶׁר פֶּחָה שָׁמוֹ.
verses.english: And also the vessels of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nevukhadneżżar took out of the temple that was in Yerushalayim, and brought into the temple of Bavel, these did Koresh the king take out of the temple of Bavel, and they were delivered to one, whose name was Sheshbażżar, whom he had made governor;

verses.hebrew: וְאָמַר לוֹ: אֵלֶּה הַכֵּלִים שָׂא, לֵךְ הוֹרֵד אוֹתָם בַּהֵיכָל אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים יִבָּנֶה עַל מְקוֹמוֹ.
verses.english: and he said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Yerushalayim, and let the house of God be built on its place.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר זֶה בָּא, נָתַן יְסוֹדוֹת שֶׁל בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וּמֵאָז וְעַד כָּעֵת הוּא נִבְנֶה וְלֹא נִשְׁלָם.
verses.english: Then came the same Sheshbażżar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Yerushalayim: and since that time even until now it has been in building, and it is still not finished.

verses.hebrew: וְכָעֵת, אִם עַל הַמֶּלֶךְ טוֹב, יְבֻקַּר בְּבֵית הַגְּנָזִים שֶׁל הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁם אֲשֶׁר בְּבָבֶל, אִם יֵשׁ שֶׁמִּכּוֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ הוּשַׂם צַו לִבְנוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהִים זֶה בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, וּרְצוֹן הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל זֶה יִשְׁלַח אֵלֵינוּ.
verses.english: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Bavel, whether it be so, that a decree was made by Koresh the king to build this house of God at Yerushalayim, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂם צַו, וּבִקְּרוּ בְּבֵית הַסְּפָרִים, אֲשֶׁר אֶת הַגְּנָזִים מוֹרִידִים שָׁמָּה בְּבָבֶל.
verses.english: Then Daryavesh the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Bavel.

verses.hebrew: וְנִמְצָא בְאַחְמְתָא, בַּבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר בְּמָדַי הַמְּדִינָה, מְגִלָּה אַחַת, וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹכָהּ: הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
verses.english: And there was found at Aĥmeta, the fortress that is in the province of Maday, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ, כּוֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂם צַו: בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם הַבַּיִת יִבָּנֶה, מָקוֹם שֶׁזּוֹבְחִים זְבָחִים וִיסוֹדָיו מוּקָמִים, רוּמוֹ אַמּוֹת שִׁשִּׁים, רָחְבּוֹ אַמּוֹת שִׁשִּׁים.
verses.english: In the first year of Koresh the king, the same Koresh the king made a decree, Concerning the house of God at Yerushalayim; let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid; its height sixty cubits, and its breadth sixty cubits;

verses.hebrew: נִדְבָּכִים שֶׁל אֶבֶן גָּלָל שְׁלשָׁה, וְנִדְבָּךְ שֶׁל עֵץ אֶחָד, וְהַהוֹצָאָה מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תִּנָּתֵן.
verses.english: with three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be paid out of the king’s house:

verses.hebrew: וְאַף כְּלֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים שֶׁל זָהָב וָכֶסֶף, אֲשֶׁר נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הוֹצִיא מִן הַהֵיכָל אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם וְהוֹבִיל לְבָבֶל, יָשִׁיבוּ, וְיֵלֵךְ לַהֵיכָל אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם לִמְקוֹמוֹ, וְתוֹרִיד בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים.
verses.english: and also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God which Nevukhadneżżar took out of the temple which is at Yerushalayim, and brought to Bavel, be restored, and brought back to the temple which is at Yerushalayim, every one to its place, and place them in the house of God.

verses.hebrew: כָּעֵת, תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וְחַבְרֵיהֶם, הַפַּרְסִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, מְרֻחָקִים הֱיוּ מִשָּׁם.
verses.english: Now Tattenay, governor beyond the river, Shetar-bozenay, and your associates, the Afarsekhites, who are beyond the river, keep far from hence:

verses.hebrew: הַנִּיחוּ לַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה, פַּחַת הַיְּהוּדִים וּלְזִקְנֵי הַיְּהוּדִים, בֵּית אֱלֹהִים זֶה יִבְנוּ עַל מְקוֹמוֹ.
verses.english: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנִּי הוּשַׂם צַו, לְמַה שֶׁתַּעֲשׂוּ עִם זִקְנֵי הַיְּהוּדִים הָאֵלֶּה, לִבְנוֹת אֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה, וּמִנִּכְסֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁמַּתַּת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, בִּמְהֵרָה הַהוֹצָאָה תִּהְיֶה נִתֶּנֶת לָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה, שֶׁלֹּא לְבַטֵּל.
verses.english: Moreover I make a decree as to what you shall do for the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, expenses be given with all diligence to these men so that they are not delayed.

verses.hebrew: וּמַה שֶׁצָּרִיךְ, וּבְנֵי בָקָר וְאֵילִים וּכְבָשִׁים לְעוֹלוֹת לֵאלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, חִטִּים, מֶלַח, יַיִן וָשֶׁמֶן, כְּמַאֲמַר הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, יְהִי נִתָּן לָהֶם יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּלֹא מִשְׁגֶּה.
verses.english: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Yerushalayim, let it be given them day by day without fail:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ מַקְרִיבִים נִיחוֹחִים לֵאלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, וּמִתְפַּלְּלִים לְחַיֵּי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבָנָיו.
verses.english: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savour to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנִּי הוּשַׂם צַו, שֶׁכָּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁנֶּה דָּבָר זֶה, יֻסַּח עֵץ מִבֵּיתוֹ, וְזָקוּף יֻכֶּה עָלָיו, וּבֵיתוֹ אַשְׁפָּה יֵעָשֶׂה עַל זֶה.
verses.english: Also I have made a decree, that whoever shall alter this word, let a beam of a timber be pulled down from his house, and let him be lifted up and impaled thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֱלֹהִים, אֲשֶׁר שִׁכֵּן שְׁמוֹ שָׁם, יְמַגֵּר כָּל מֶלֶךְ וְעַם, אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ לְשַׁנּוֹת, לְחַבֵּל אֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם; אֲנִי דָרְיָוֶשׁ נָתַתִּי צַו, מְהֵרָה יֵעָשֶׂה!
verses.english: And may the God who has caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and peoples, that shall put to their hand to alter this, or to destroy this house of God which is at Yerushalayim. I Daryavesh have made a decree; let it be done with diligence.

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וְחַבְרֵיהֶם, לְעֻמַּת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ, כֵּן מְהֵרָה עָשׂוּ.
verses.english: Then Tattenay governor on this side of the river, Shetar-bozenay, and their associates, according to that which Daryavesh the king had sent, so they did with diligence.

verses.hebrew: וְזִקְנֵי הַיְּהוּדִים בּוֹנִים וּמַצְלִיחִים, בִּנְבוּאַת חַגַּי הַנָּבִיא וּזְכַרְיָה בֶּן עִדּוֹא, וּבָנוּ וְתִקְּנוּ, בְּמִצְוַת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּבְמִצְוַת כּוֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס.
verses.english: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Ḥaggay the prophet and Zekharya the son of ῾Iddo. And they built, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Yisra᾽el, and according to the commandment of Koresh, and Daryavesh, and Artaĥshasta king of Paras.

verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁלַם בַּיִת זֶה עַד יוֹם שלשה לְחֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר, שֶׁהִיא שְׁנַת שֵׁשׁ לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ.
verses.english: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Daryavesh the king.

verses.hebrew: וְעָשׂוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְּוִיִּים וּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה, חֲנֻכַּת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה בְּחֶדְוָה.
verses.english: And the children of Yisra᾽el, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the exile, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיבוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה, פָּרִים מֵאָה, אֵילִים מָאתַיִם, כְּבָשִׁים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת, וּצְפִירֵי עִזִּים, לְחַטֵּא עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל, שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר, לְמִנְיַן שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
verses.english: and they offered at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Yisra᾽el, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵקִימוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים בִּפְלֻגּוֹתֵיהֶם, וְהַלְּוִיִּים בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶם, עַל עֲבוֹדַת הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם, כִּכְתָב סֵפֶר מֹשֶׁה.
verses.english: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Yerushalayim; as it is written in the book of Moshe.
Now after these things, in the reign of Artaĥshasta king of Paras, ῾Ezra the son of Seraya, the son of ῾Azarya, the son of Ḥilqiyya,
the son of Shallum, the son of Żadoq, the son of Aĥituv,
the son of Amarya, the son of ῾Azarya, the son of Merayot,
the son of Zeraĥya, the son of ῾Uzzi, the son of Buqqi,
the son of Avishua, the son of Pineĥas, the son of El῾azar, the son of Aharon the chief priest: –

this ῾Ezra went up from Bavel; and he was a ready scribe in the Tora of Moshe, which the Lord God of Yisra᾽el had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.

And there went up some of the children of Yisra᾽el, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, to Yerushalayim, in the seventh year of Artaĥshasta the king.
And he came to Yerushalayim in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

For upon the first day of the first month was the beginning of the going up from Bavel, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Yerushalayim, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
For ῾Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the Tora of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Yisra᾽el statutes and judgments.
Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaĥshasta gave to ῾Ezra the priest, the scribe, learned in the words of the commandments of the Lord, and of his statutes to Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מֶלֶךְ הַמְּלָכִים, לְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן סוֹפֵר הַדָּת שֶׁל אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, (שָׁלוֹם) גָּמוּר, וְכָעֵת.
verses.english: Artaĥshasta, king of kings, to ῾Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, a perfect man. And now,

verses.hebrew: מִמֶּנִּי הוּשַׂם צַו, שֶׁכָּל מִתְנַדֵּב בְּמַלְכוּתִי מֵעַם יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹהֲנָיו וְהַלְּוִיִּים לָלֶכֶת לִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִמְּךָ, יֵלֵךְ.
verses.english: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Yisra᾽el, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, who are minded of their own freewill to go up to Yerushalayim, may go with thee.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עֻמַּת שֶׁמִּלִּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשִׁבְעַת יוֹעֲצָיו נִשְׁלַח, לְבַקֵּר אֶל יְהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם, בְּדָת אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ.
verses.english: For thou art sent by the king, and by his seven counsellors, to inquire concerning Yehuda and Yerushalayim, according to the law of thy God which is in thy hand;

verses.hebrew: וּלְהוֹבִיל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב, אֲשֶׁר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיוֹעֲצָיו הִתְנַדְּבוּ לֶאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם מִשְׁכָּנוֹ.
verses.english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Yisra᾽el, whose habitation is in Yerushalayim,

verses.hebrew: וְכָל כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב, אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא בְּכָל מְדִינַת בָּבֶל, עִם הִתְנַדְּבוּת הָעָם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים, מִתְנַדְּבִים לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלַיִם.
verses.english: and all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Bavel, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Yerushalayim:

verses.hebrew: כָּל־עֻמַּת זֶה בְּמֶרֶץ תִּקְנֶה בְּכֶסֶף זֶה פָּרִים, אֵילִים, כְּבָשִׂים וּמִנְחוֹתֵיהֶם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם, וְתַקְרִיב אוֹתָם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁל בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שֶׁבִּירוּשָׁלַיִם.
verses.english: that thou mayst buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וּמַה שֶׁעָלֶיךָ וְעַל אַחֶיךָ יִיטַב, בִּשְׁאָר הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב לַעֲשׂוֹת, כִּרְצוֹן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ.
verses.english: And whatever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֵּלִים, אֲשֶׁר נִתָּנִים לְךָ לַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית אֱלֹהֶיךָ, מְסֹר לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵי יְרוּשָׁלַיִם.
verses.english: And the vessels that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver before the God of Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר צֹרֶךְ בֵּית אֱלֹהֶיךָ, אֲשֶׁר יוּטַל עָלֶיךָ לָתֵת, תִּתֵּן מִבֵּית גִּנְזֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ.
verses.english: And what more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.

verses.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנִּי אֲנִי אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ, הוּשַׂם צַו לְכָל הַגִּזְבָּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, שֶׁכָּל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאַלְכֶם עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן, סוֹפֵר הַדָּת שֶׁל אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, בְּמֶרֶץ יֵעָשֶׂה.
verses.english: And I, even I Artaĥshasta the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the river, that whatever ῾Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done with diligence,

verses.hebrew: עַד כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים מֵאָה, וְעַד חִטִּים כּוֹרִים מֵאָה, וְעַד יַיִן בַּתִּים מֵאָה, וְעַד בַּתִּים שֶׁמֶן מֵאָה, וּמֶלַח לְלֹא כְתָב.
verses.english: up to a hundred talents of silver, and up to a hundred measures of wheat, and up to a hundred bats of wine, and up to a hundred bats of oil, and salt without prescribed limit.

verses.hebrew: כָּל אֲשֶׁר מִמִּצְוַת אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, יֵעָשֶׂה אֶל נָכוֹן לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם, שַׁלָּמָה יִהְיֶה קֶצֶף עַל מַלְכוּת הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבָנָיו.
verses.english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be speedily done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

verses.hebrew: וְלָכֶם מוֹדִיעִים, אֲשֶׁר כָּל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְּוִיִּים, הַמְּשׁוֹרְרִים, הַשּׁוֹעֲרִים, הַנְּתִינִים וְעוֹבְדֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים הַזֶּה, מַתָּת מִנְחָה וּמַס אֵין רַשַּׁאי לְהַטִּיל עֲלֵיהֶם.
verses.english: We also notify you, that as regards any of the priests and Levites, singers, gatekeepers, servants, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה עֶזְרָא, כְּחָכְמַת אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדְךָ מַנֵּה שׁוֹפְטִים וְדַיָּנִים, אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ דָנִים אֶת כָּל הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר, אֶת כָּל יוֹדְעֵי דָת אֱלֹהֶיךָ, וַאֲשֶׁר אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ – תּוֹדִיעוֹ.
verses.english: And thou, ῾Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thy hand, appoint magistrates and judges, who may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach them who do not know them.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִהְיֶה עוֹשֶׂה דָת אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְדָת הַמֶּלֶךְ, בְּמֶרֶץ הַדִּין יִהְיֶה נַעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ, אִם לְמָוֶת אִם לְגָלוּת, אִם לְעֹנֶשׁ כְּסָפִים וְלֶאֱסוּרִים.
verses.english: And whoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be with diligence executed upon him, whether it be for death, or for banishment, or for confiscation of goods, or for imprisonment.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אֲבֹתֵיהֶם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם הָעֹלִים עִמִּי בְּמַלְכוּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבָּבֶל׃
verses.english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ houses, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Bavel, in the reign of Artaĥshasta the king.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי פִינְחָס גֵּרְשֹׁם מִבְּנֵי אִיתָמָר דָּנִיֵּאל מִבְּנֵי דָוִיד חַטּוּשׁ׃
verses.english: Of the sons of Pineĥas, Gershom: of the sons of Itamar, Daniyyel: of the sons of David, Ḥattush:

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ זְכַרְיָה וְעִמּוֹ הִתְיַחֵשׂ לִזְכָרִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃
verses.english: of the sons of Shekhanya, of the sons of Par῾osh, Zekharya; and with him were reckoned by genealogy one hundred and fifty males.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי בֶּן־זְרַחְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: Of the sons of Paĥat-mo᾽av, Elyeho῾enay the son of Zeraĥya; and with him two hundred males.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה בֶּן־יַחֲזִיאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: Of the sons of Shekhanya, the son of Yaĥazi᾽el and with him three hundred males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עָדִין עֶבֶד בֶּן־יוֹנָתָן וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of ῾Adin, ῾Eved the son of Yonatan; and with him fifty males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם יְשַׁעְיָה בֶּן־עֲתַלְיָה וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of ῾Elam, Yesha῾ya the son of ῾Atalya; and with him seventy males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה זְבַדְיָה בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁמֹנִים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Shefatya, Zevadya the son of Mikha᾽el; and with him eighty males.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי יוֹאָב עֹבַדְיָה בֶּן־יְחִיאֵל וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם וּשְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: Of the sons of Yo᾽av, ῾Ovadya the son of Yeĥi᾽el; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁלוֹמִית בֶּן־יוֹסִפְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וְשִׁשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Shelomit, the son of Yosifya; and with him one hundred and sixty males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵבַי זְכַרְיָה בֶּן־בֵּבָי וְעִמּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Bevay, Zekharya the son of Bevay: and with him twenty eight males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עַזְגָּד יוֹחָנָן בֶּן־הַקָּטָן וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וַעֲשָׂרָה הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of ῾Azgad, Yoĥanan the son of Haqqatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנִיקָם אַחֲרֹנִים וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם אֱלִיפֶלֶט יְעִיאֵל וּשְׁמַעְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם שִׁשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Adoniqam (who came in the rear,) these were their names: Elifelet, Ye῾i᾽el, and Shema῾ya; and with them were sixty males.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בִגְוַי עוּתַי וזבוד [וְזַכּוּר] וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִים׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Bigvay, ῾Utay and Zakkur; and with them were seventy males.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקְבְּצֵם אֶל־הַנָּהָר הַבָּא אֶל־אַהֲוָא וַנַּחֲנֶה שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וָאָבִינָה בָעָם וּבַכֹּהֲנִים וּמִבְּנֵי לֵוִי לֹא־מָצָאתִי שָׁם׃
verses.english: And I gathered them together at the river that runs to Ahava, and we encamped there for three days: and I inspected the people, and the priests, but found there none of the sons of Levi.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלְחָה לֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר לַאֲרִיאֵל לִשְׁמַעְיָה וּלְאֶלְנָתָן וּלְיָרִיב וּלְאֶלְנָתָן וּלְנָתָן וְלִזְכַרְיָה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּם רָאשִׁים וּלְיוֹיָרִיב וּלְאֶלְנָתָן מְבִינִים׃
verses.english: So I sent for Eli῾ezer, for Ari᾽el, for Shema῾ya, and for Elnatan, and for Yariv, and for Elnatan, and for Natan, and for Zekharya, and for Meshullam, chief men: and for Yoyariv, and for Elnatan, men of understanding.

verses.hebrew: ואוצאה [וָאֲצַוֶּה] אוֹתָם עַל־אִדּוֹ הָרֹאשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם וָאָשִׂימָה בְּפִיהֶם דְּבָרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל־אִדּוֹ אָחִיו הנתונים [הַנְּתִינִים] בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם לְהָבִיא־לָנוּ מְשָׁרְתִים לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: And I sent them with commandment to ῾Iddo the chief at the place Kasifya, and I told them what they should say to ῾Iddo, and to his brother who were appointed at the place Kasifya that they should bring to us ministers for the house of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאּוּ לָנוּ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַטּוֹבָה עָלֵינוּ אִישׁ שֶׂכֶל מִבְּנֵי מַחְלִי בֶּן־לֵוִי בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֵׁרֵבְיָה וּבָנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר׃
verses.english: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Maĥli, the son of Levi, the son of Yisra᾽el; and Sherevya, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חֲשַׁבְיָה וְאִתּוֹ יְשַׁעְיָה מִבְּנֵי מְרָרִי אֶחָיו וּבְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים׃
verses.english: and Ḥashavya, and with him Yesha῾ya of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַנְּתִינִים שֶׁנָּתַן דָּוִיד וְהַשָּׂרִים לַעֲבֹדַת הַלְוִיִּם נְתִינִים מָאתַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים כֻּלָּם נִקְּבוּ בְשֵׁמוֹת׃
verses.english: also of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty temple servants; all of whom were mentioned by name.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶקְרָא שָׁם צוֹם עַל־הַנָּהָר אַהֲוָא לְהִתְעַנּוֹת לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָנוּ וּלְטַפֵּנוּ וּלְכָל־רְכוּשֵׁנוּ׃
verses.english: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a safe journey for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בֹשְׁתִּי לִשְׁאוֹל מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ חַיִל וּפָרָשִׁים לְעָזְרֵנוּ מֵאוֹיֵב בַּדָּרֶךְ כִּי־אָמַרְנוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר יַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־כָּל־מְבַקְשָׁיו לְטוֹבָה וְעֻזּוֹ וְאַפּוֹ עַל כָּל־עֹזְבָיו׃
verses.english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the road: because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all those who seek him for good; but his power and his wrath are against all those who forsake him.

verses.hebrew: וַנָּצוּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁה מֵאֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־זֹאת וַיֵּעָתֵר לָנוּ׃
verses.english: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he listened to our entreaty.

verses.hebrew: וָאַבְדִּילָה מִשָּׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְשֵׁרֵבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם מֵאֲחֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃
verses.english: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherevya, Ḥashavya, and ten of their brethren with them,

verses.hebrew: ואשקולה [וָאֶשְׁקֳלָה] לָהֶם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים תְּרוּמַת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַהֵרִימוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיֹעֲצָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצָאִים׃
verses.english: and weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Yisra᾽el there present, had offered:

verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָה עַל־יָדָם כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף מֵאָה לְכִכָּרִים זָהָב מֵאָה כִכָּר׃
verses.english: so I weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and of silver vessels a hundred talents, and of gold a hundred talents;

verses.hebrew: וּכְפֹרֵי זָהָב עֶשְׂרִים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִים אָלֶף וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת מֻצְהָב טוֹבָה שְׁנַיִם חֲמוּדֹת כַּזָּהָב׃
verses.english: also twenty bowls of gold, of a thousand darics; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה וְהַכֵּלִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נְדָבָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the Lord God of your fathers.

verses.hebrew: שִׁקְדוּ וְשִׁמְרוּ עַד־תִּשְׁקְלוּ לִפְנֵי שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְשָׂרֵי־הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלִָם הַלִּשְׁכוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Watch, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Yisra᾽el, at Yerushalayim, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים לְהָבִיא לִירוּשָׁלִַם לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Yerushalayim to the house of our God.

verses.hebrew: וַנִּסְעָה מִנְּהַר אַהֲוָא בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לָלֶכֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָיְתָה עָלֵינוּ וַיַּצִּילֵנוּ מִכַּף אוֹיֵב וְאוֹרֵב עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Yerushalayim: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lie in wait by the way.

verses.hebrew: וַנָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַנֵּשֶׁב שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: And we came to Yerushalayim, and abode there three days.

verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי נִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים בְּבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל יַד־מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְעִמּוֹ אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־פִּינְחָס וְעִמָּהֶם יוֹזָבָד בֶּן־יֵשׁוּעַ וְנוֹעַדְיָה בֶן־בִּנּוּי הַלְוִיִּם׃
verses.english: Now on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremot the son of Uriyya the priest; and with him was El῾azar the son of Pineĥas; and with them was Yozavad the son of Yeshua, and No῾adya the son of Binnuy, Levites;

verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפָּר בְּמִשְׁקָל לַכֹּל וַיִּכָּתֵב כָּל־הַמִּשְׁקָל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃
verses.english: the whole was counted and weighed: and the weight of everything was recorded at that time.

verses.hebrew: הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָה הִקְרִיבוּ עֹלוֹת לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרִים שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילִים תִּשְׁעִים וְשִׁשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה צְפִירֵי חַטָּאת שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַכֹּל עוֹלָה לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: Also the children of those who had been carried away, who were come out of the exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Yisra᾽el, twelve bullocks for all Yisra᾽el, ninety six rams, seventy seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּפַחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְנִשְּׂאוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְאֶת־בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: And they delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s satraps, and to the governors on this side of the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

verses.hebrew: וּכְכַלּוֹת אֵלֶּה נִגְּשׁוּ אֵלַי הַשָּׂרִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־נִבְדְּלוּ הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם לַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַיְבוּסִי הָעַמֹּנִי הַמֹּאָבִי הַמִּצְרִי וְהָאֱמֹרִי׃
verses.english: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Yisra᾽el, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Kena῾ani, the Ḥitti, the Perizzi, the Yevusi, the ῾Ammoni, the Mo᾽avi, the Mizri, and the Emori.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָשְׂאוּ מִבְּנֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם וְהִתְעָרְבוּ זֶרַע הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְיַד הַשָּׂרִים וְהַסְּגָנִים הָיְתָה בַּמַּעַל הַזֶּה רִאשׁוֹנָה׃
verses.english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the peoples of those lands: indeed, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this crime.

verses.hebrew: וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה קָרַעְתִּי אֶת־בִּגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶמְרְטָה מִשְּׂעַר רֹאשִׁי וּזְקָנִי וָאֵשְׁבָה מְשׁוֹמֵם׃
verses.english: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down appalled.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלַי יֵאָסְפוּ כֹּל חָרֵד בְּדִבְרֵי אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה וַאֲנִי יֹשֵׁב מְשׁוֹמֵם עַד לְמִנְחַת הָעָרֶב׃
verses.english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Yisra᾽el, because of the transgression of those who had been carried away gathered around me; and I sat appalled until the evening sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וּבְמִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב קַמְתִּי מִתַּעֲנִיתִי וּבְקָרְעִי בִגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶכְרְעָה עַל־בִּרְכַּי וָאֶפְרְשָׂה כַפַּי אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: And at the evening sacrifice I arose from my fasting; and my garment and my mantle being rent, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands to the Lord my God,

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה אֱלֹהַי בֹּשְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַמְתִּי לְהָרִים אֱלֹהַי פָּנַי אֵלֶיךָ כִּי עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ רָבוּ לְמַעְלָה רֹּאשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ גָדְלָה עַד לַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: and said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to Thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our guilt has mounted to the heavens.

verses.hebrew: מִימֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּאַשְׁמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ נִתַּנּוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מְלָכֵינוּ כֹהֲנֵינוּ בְּיַד מַלְכֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת בַּחֶרֶב בַּשְּׁבִי וּבַבִּזָּה וּבְבֹשֶׁת פָּנִים כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests, have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to plundering, and to utter shame, as it is this day.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּמְעַט־רֶגַע הָיְתָה תְחִנָּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַשְׁאִיר לָנוּ פְּלֵיטָה וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ יָתֵד בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ לְהָאִיר עֵינֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְתִתֵּנוּ מִחְיָה מְעַט בְּעַבְדֻתֵנוּ׃
verses.english: And now for a little moment grace has been shown by the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a secure anchorage in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲבָדִים אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעַבְדֻתֵנוּ לֹא עֲזָבָנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיַּט־עָלֵינוּ חֶסֶד לִפְנֵי מַלְכֵי פָרַס לָתֶת־לָנוּ מִחְיָה לְרוֹמֵם אֶת־בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־חָרְבֹתָיו וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ גָדֵר בִּיהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: For we were slaves; yet our God did not forsake us in our slavery but gave us grace in the sight of the kings of Paras; to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Yehuda and in Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־נֹּאמַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת כִּי עָזַבְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken Thy commandments,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ בְּיַד עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ נִדָּה הִיא בְּנִדַּת עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת בְּתוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר מִלְאוּהָ מִפֶּה אֶל־פֶּה בְּטֻמְאָתָם׃
verses.english: which Thou hast commanded by Thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, into which you go to possess it, is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations, for they have filled it from one end to the other with their uncleanness.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם אַל־תִּתְּנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם אַל־תִּשְׂאוּ לִבְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא־תִדְרְשׁוּ שְׁלֹמָם וְטוֹבָתָם עַד־עוֹלָם לְמַעַן תֶּחֶזְקוּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֶת־טוּב הָאָרֶץ וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם לִבְנֵיכֶם עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Now therefore do not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their welfare for ever: that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂינוּ הָרָעִים וּבְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ הַגְּדֹלָה כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ חָשַׂכְתָּ לְמַטָּה מֵעֲוֺנֵנוּ וְנָתַתָּה לָּנוּ פְּלֵיטָה כָּזֹאת׃
verses.english: And after all that which has come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, seeing that Thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;

verses.hebrew: הֲנָשׁוּב לְהָפֵר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ וּלְהִתְחַתֵּן בְּעַמֵּי הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֲלוֹא תֶאֱנַף־בָּנוּ עַד־כַּלֵּה לְאֵין שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה׃
verses.english: should we again break Thy commandments, and make marriages with the peoples of these abominations? wouldst Thou not be angry with us till Thou wouldst consume us, so that there should be no remnant nor any to escape?

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל צַדִּיק אַתָּה כִּי־נִשְׁאַרְנוּ פְלֵיטָה כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַשְׁמָתֵינוּ כִּי אֵין לַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ עַל־זֹאת׃
verses.english: O Lord God of Yisra᾽el, Thou are righteous: for we are left, a remnant that is escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before Thee in our guiltiness: but we cannot stand before Thee because of this.

verses.hebrew: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּל עֶזְרָא וּכְהִתְוַדֹּתוֹ בֹּכֶה וּמִתְנַפֵּל לִפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלָיו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קָהָל רַב־מְאֹד אֲנָשִׁים וְנָשִׁים וִילָדִים כִּי־בָכוּ הָעָם הַרְבֵּה־בֶכֶה׃
verses.english: Now when ῾Ezra had prayed, and when he had made confession, weeping and casting himself before the house of God, there assembled to him out of Yisra᾽el a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very bitterly.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן שְׁכַנְיָה בֶן־יְחִיאֵל מִבְּנֵי עולם [עֵילָם] וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֶזְרָא אֲנַחְנוּ מָעַלְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵינוּ וַנֹּשֶׁב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְעַתָּה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־זֹאת׃
verses.english: And Shekhanya the son of Yeĥi᾽el, one of the sons of ῾Elam, answered and said to ῾Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken alien women of the peoples of the land: yet now there is hope in Yisra᾽el concerning this thing.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נִכְרָת־בְּרִית לֵאלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִיא כָל־נָשִׁים וְהַנּוֹלָד מֵהֶם בַּעֲצַת אֲדֹנָי וְהַחֲרֵדִים בְּמִצְוַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָה יֵעָשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all such women, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the Tora.

verses.hebrew: קוּם כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר וַאֲנַחְנוּ עִמָּךְ חֲזַק וַעֲשֵׂה׃
verses.english: Arise; for it is thy task: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא וַיַּשְׁבַּע אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשָּׁבֵעוּ׃
verses.english: Then ῾Ezra arose, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Yisra᾽el swear that they would do according to this word. And they swore.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא מִלִּפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת יְהוֹחָנָן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם לֶחֶם לֹא־אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא־שָׁתָה כִּי מִתְאַבֵּל עַל־מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה׃
verses.english: Then ῾Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Yoĥanan the son of Elyashiv: and when he came there, he ate no bread, nor drank water: for he mourned because of the transgression of the exiles.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בִּיהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם לְכֹל בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה לְהִקָּבֵץ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And they made proclamation throughout Yehuda and Yerushalayim to all the children of the exile, that they should gather themselves together to Yerushalayim;

verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָבוֹא לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים כַּעֲצַת הַשָּׂרִים וְהַזְּקֵנִים יָחֳרַם כָּל־רְכוּשׁוֹ וְהוּא יִבָּדֵל מִקְּהַל הַגּוֹלָה׃
verses.english: and that whoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of the exiles.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן יְרוּשָׁלִַם לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים הוּא חֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ כָל־הָעָם בִּרְחוֹב בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים מַרְעִידִים עַל־הַדָּבָר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִים׃
verses.english: Then all the men of Yehuda and Binyamin gathered themselves together to Yerushalayim within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the open place before the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and on account of the great rain.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם מְעַלְתֶּם וַתֹּשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת לְהוֹסִיף עַל־אַשְׁמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And ῾Ezra the priest stood up, and said to them, You have transgressed, and have taken alien women to increase the guilt of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ תוֹדָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַעֲשׂוּ רְצוֹנוֹ וְהִבָּדְלוּ מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וּמִן־הַנָּשִׁים הַנָּכְרִיּוֹת׃
verses.english: Now therefore make confession to the Lord God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the alien women.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְנוּ כָל־הַקָּהָל וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוֹל גָּדוֹל כֵּן כדבריך [כִּדְבָרְךָ] עָלֵינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
verses.english: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice. As thou hast said, so must we do.

verses.hebrew: אֲבָל הָעָם רָב וְהָעֵת גְּשָׁמִים וְאֵין כֹּחַ לַעֲמוֹד בַּחוּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָה לֹא־לְיוֹם אֶחָד וְלֹא לִשְׁנַיִם כִּי־הִרְבִּינוּ לִפְשֹׁעַ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside, nor is this a work of one day or two: for we are many who have transgressed in this thing.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲמְדוּ־נָא שָׂרֵינוּ לְכָל־הַקָּהָל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָרֵינוּ הַהֹשִׁיב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת יָבֹא לְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים וְעִמָּהֶם זִקְנֵי־עִיר וָעִיר וְשֹׁפְטֶיהָ עַד לְהָשִׁיב חֲרוֹן אַף־אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all those who have taken foreign women in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and their judges, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter is turned away from us.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־עֲשָׂהאֵל וְיַחְזְיָה בֶן־תִּקְוָה עָמְדוּ עַל־זֹאת וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְשַׁבְּתַי הַלֵּוִי עֲזָרֻם׃
verses.english: Only Yonatan the son of ῾Asa᾽el and Yaĥzeya the son of Tiqva stood out against this: and Meshullam and Shabbetay the Levite helped them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וַיִּבָּדְלוּ עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וְכֻלָּם בְּשֵׁמוֹת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי לְדַרְיוֹשׁ הַדָּבָר׃
verses.english: And the children of the exile did so. And certain chiefs of the fathers’ houses after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated by ῾Ezra the priest, and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלּוּ בַכֹּל אֲנָשִׁים הַהֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת עַד יוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃
verses.english: And they made an end of the whole matter of the men who had taken foreign women by the first day of the first month.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּצֵא מִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מִבְּנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו מַעֲשֵׂיָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר וְיָרִיב וּגְדַלְיָה׃
verses.english: And among the sons of the priests there were found such as had taken foreign women: namely, of the sons of Yeshua the son of Yożadaq, and his brothers; Ma῾aseya, and Eli῾ezer, and Yariv, and Gedalya.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ יָדָם לְהוֹצִיא נְשֵׁיהֶם וַאֲשֵׁמִים אֵיל־צֹאן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָם׃
verses.english: And they gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי אִמֵּר חֲנָנִי וּזְבַדְיָה׃
verses.english: And of the sons of Immer; Ḥanani, and Zevadya;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי חָרִם מַעֲשֵׂיָה וְאֵלִיָּה וּשְׁמַעְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעֻזִיָּה׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Ḥarim, Ma῾aseya and Eliyya, and Shema῾ya, and Yeĥi᾽el, and ῾Uzziyya;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּשְׁחוּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי מַעֲשֵׂיָה יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְתַנְאֵל יוֹזָבָד וְאֶלְעָשָׂה׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Pashĥur, Elyo῾enay, Ma῾aseya, Yishma᾽el, Netan᾽el, Yozavad, and El῾asa;

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם יוֹזָבָד וְשִׁמְעִי וְקֵלָיָה הוּא קְלִיטָא פְּתַחְיָה יְהוּדָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר׃
verses.english: and of the Levites, Yozavad, and Sim῾i, and Qelaya, (the same is Qelita,) Petaĥya, Yehuda, and Eli῾ezer;

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַמְשֹׁרְרִים אֶלְיָשִׁיב וּמִן־הַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלֻּם וָטֶלֶם וְאוּרִי׃
verses.english: and of the singers, Elyashiv; and of the gatekeepers, Shallum, and Telem, and Uri;

verses.hebrew: וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ רַמְיָה וְיִזִּיָּה וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּמִיָּמִן וְאֶלְעָזָר וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּבְנָיָה׃
verses.english: and of Yisra᾽el: of the sons of Par῾osh, Ramya, and Yizziyya, and Malkiyya, and Miyyamin, and El῾azar, and Malkiyya, and Benaya;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם מַתַּנְיָה זְכַרְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעַבְדִּי וִירֵמוֹת וְאֵלִיָּה׃
verses.english: and of the sons of ῾Elam, Mattanya, Zekharya, and Yeĥi᾽el, and ῾Avdi, and Yeremot, and Eliyya;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי זַתּוּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַי אֶלְיָשִׁיב מַתַּנְיָה וִירֵמוֹת וְזָבָד וַעֲזִיזָא׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Zattu, Elyo῾enay, Elyashiv. Mattanya, and Yeremot, and Zavad, and ῾Aziza;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵּבָי יְהוֹחָנָן חֲנַנְיָה זַבַּי עַתְלָי׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Bevay, Yehoĥanan, Ḥananya, Zabbay, and ῾Atlay;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בָּנִי מְשֻׁלָּם מַלּוּךְ וַעֲדָיָה יָשׁוּב וּשְׁאָל ירמות [וְרָמוֹת׃]
verses.english: and of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malukh, and ῾Adaya, Yashuv, and She᾽al, and Ramot;

verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב עַדְנָא וּכְלָל בְּנָיָה מַעֲשֵׂיָה מַתַּנְיָה בְצַלְאֵל וּבִנּוּי וּמְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Paĥat-mo᾽av, ῾Adna, and Kelal, Benaya, Ma῾aseya, Mattanya, Beżal᾽el, and Binnuy, and Menashshe;

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חָרִם אֱלִיעֶזֶר יִשִּׁיָּה מַלְכִּיָּה שְׁמַעְיָה שִׁמְעוֹן׃
verses.english: and of the sons of Ḥarim, Eli῾ezer, Yishshiyya, Malkiyya, Shema῾ya, Shim῾on,

verses.hebrew: בְּנְיָמִן מַלּוּךְ שְׁמַרְיָה׃
verses.english: Binyamin, Malukh, Shemarya;

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי חָשֻׁם מַתְּנַי מַתַּתָּה זָבָד אֱלִיפֶלֶט יְרֵמַי מְנַשֶּׁה שִׁמְעִי׃
verses.english: of the sons of Ḥashum, Mattenay, Mattatta, Zavad, Elifelet, Yeremay, Menashshe, Shim῾i;

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי בָנִי מַעֲדַי עַמְרָם וְאוּאֵל׃
verses.english: of the sons of Bani, Ma῾aday, ῾Amram, and U᾽el,

verses.hebrew: בְּנָיָה בֵדְיָה כלהי [כְּלוּהוּ׃]
verses.english: Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhu,

verses.hebrew: וַנְיָה מְרֵמוֹת אֶלְיָשִׁיב׃
verses.english: Vanya, Meremot, Elyashiv,

verses.hebrew: מַתַּנְיָה מַתְּנַי ויעשו [וְיַעֲשָׂי׃]
verses.english: Mattanya, Mattenay, and Ya῾asay,

verses.hebrew: וּבָנִי וּבִנּוּי שִׁמְעִי׃
verses.english: and Bani, and Binnuy, Shim῾i,

verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁלֶמְיָה וְנָתָן וַעֲדָיָה׃
verses.english: Shelemya, and Natan, and ῾Adaya,

verses.hebrew: מַכְנַדְבַי שָׁשַׁי שָׁרָי׃
verses.english: Makhnadvay, Shashay, Sharay,

verses.hebrew: עֲזַרְאֵל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ שְׁמַרְיָה׃
verses.english: ῾Azar᾽el, and Shelemyahu, Shemarya,

verses.hebrew: שַׁלּוּם אֲמַרְיָה יוֹסֵף׃
verses.english: Shallum, Amarya, and Yosef.

verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי נְבוֹ יְעִיאֵל מַתִּתְיָה זָבָד זְבִינָא ידו [יַדַּי] וְיוֹאֵל בְּנָיָה׃
verses.english: Of the sons of Nevo, Ye῾i᾽el, Mattitya, Zavad, Zevina, Yadday, and Yo᾽el, Benaya.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה נשאי [נָשְׂאוּ] נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת וְיֵשׁ מֵהֶם נָשִׁים וַיָּשִׂימוּ בָּנִים׃
